summary: Added `vloop upgrade [--yes] [--dry-run]`: compares stamp and binary versions with install.Compare, refuses downgrades and unconfirmed breaking/pre-release jumps, otherwise refreshes the CLAUDE.md section and .gitignore line and rewrites the stamp.
verified: Ran the task's verify command: go test on the touched packages passed and it printed 'gate T7 ok'.
notes: The changes list holds only CLAUDE.md and .gitignore, and only when their content would change. The stamp is rewritten and printed as 'updated .vloop/install.json' on a real run, but never appears in 'would update' lines (the gate wants exactly 'would update CLAUDE.md'). --dry-run exits 0 even for a breaking jump. A missing CLAUDE.md is created and reported as 'updated'. Symlinked targets, including the stamp, are refused via checkRepoPath before any write. README is at 198 lines: added one table row and a mention in the 'Only ... write' sentence.
